items.title: Eden Manor island (the user's own estate) - showpiece, user-approved

hints.outputs: upper-map cutout via tools/isles_into_upper.py (island id eden); cover art/covers/eden_1600.jpg + eden_800.jpg; estate island inset

items.notes: The only item the user reviews. Setting: maps.json tc_upper marker eden `src` (card facts), docs/card-digest.md, docs/upper-setting.md, docs/upper-islands-checklist.md. Build a real-world reference board BEFORE modelling (neoclassical white-stone manor, front fountain court, rear lake, visitor landing, estate-wide barrier). At user-review: put board, setting summary (Chinese, <= 15 lines), and 4 final-preview angles in ~/eden-map-review/render/isle_eden/ and move on to other items; the user's verdict is recorded with --agent user; a send-back note lives in docs/reviews/campaign/isle_eden/user-<n>.md.
